hooks.name: Block committing secrets
hooks.description: Refuses any git command that would stage or commit an environment or key file. .env.local holds UPLOAD_PASSWORD_HASH and SESSION_SECRET, and this repository is public. The guard logic lives in scripts/guard-secrets.py.

action.command: for p in scripts/guard-secrets.py mycds/scripts/guard-secrets.py "$HOME/mycds/scripts/guard-secrets.py"; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then exec python3 "$p"; fi; done; exit 0
